s0212: As a designer in the Design Studio, my role was cross-functional, spanning several Gares & Connexions products. I helped structure and evolve the design systems behind multiple digital products across the rail ecosystem.
s0213: At SNCF, some existing products are continuously improved, while others are undergoing a full technology and visual overhaul. Structuring the design systems brought design practices closer together, made shared elements easier to reuse, and introduced a more iterative delivery process.
